title: Circuit Breaker Pattern
description: Learn the circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures in microservices.

data.text: The circuit breaker pattern prevents cascading failures by stopping requests to a failing service. Netflix Hystrix and Polly are popular implementations. Amazon and Netflix both rely on circuit breakers to protect their systems during service outages.

A circuit breaker has three states: Closed (normal operation), Open (failing fast), and Half-Open (testing recovery). When failures exceed a threshold, the breaker opens and returns errors immediately without calling the failing service. After a timeout, it allows one request through to test recovery.

data.title: States Overview
items: Closed: Requests pass through; failures are counted
Open: Requests fail immediately; service is given time to recover
Half-Open: Limited requests allowed to test if service recovered
Failure threshold: Number of failures before opening the circuit
Timeout: How long to wait before testing recovery

data.title: Cascading Failures
data.text: Without circuit breakers, a slow or failing downstream service can exhaust thread pools in upstream services, causing cascading failures. Circuit breakers stop this by failing fast.

data.title: Example: Circuit Breaker with Polly (C#)

data.caption: Circuit breaker state transitions
data.definition:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Closed
    Closed --> Open: Failures exceed threshold
    Open --> HalfOpen: Timeout expires
    HalfOpen --> Closed: Test request succeeds
    HalfOpen --> Open: Test request fails
    Closed --> Closed: Success

items.question: What is the difference between circuit breaker and retry?
items.answer: Retry gives a failing service time to recover by retrying. Circuit breaker stops calling a failing service to give it time to recover and prevent resource exhaustion.

items.question: Should I use circuit breakers for all external calls?
items.answer: Use them for calls to services that can fail and recover. Do not use them for calls to databases with strong consistency requirements where you need to know the result.

items.question: What about Netflix Hystrix?
items.answer: Hystrix is in maintenance mode. Netflix recommends using resilience4j (Java) or Polly (.NET) for new projects.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Fail fast when downstream is unhealthy
Use Polly, resilience4j, or similar libraries
data.takeaway: Circuit breakers are essential for production microservices; implement them for all critical external calls.
